data.body: **P2 — Stop creating completion spans after ending their parents.** This final drain runs after the Invocation span and, for terminal executions, the Workflow span have ended. A completion received during this flush is still passed to `onOperationEnd`, producing a child or continuation outside its immutable parent interval. Establish the completion cutoff and drain accepted updates before ending parent spans; afterward, only flush the provider and leave later updates for redelivery. Apply the same ordering to `InvocationOtelPlugin` and add a blocked-final-flush containment regression.
